Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now capture the exact configuration you need and return to it in a single click. Set up a view once, filtered by assignee, due date, priority, or any combination of fields, and it stays ready whenever you need it, saving time on every repeated task.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so there's plenty of room to organize views for individual projects, recurring reports, or personal workflows without running out of space. Views aren't limited to your own account, either: any saved view can be shared with your team, giving everyone the same filtered perspective without asking them to recreate your setup from scratch.

This update is included in every paid plan, with no extra configuration or upgrade required. It's a small change that adds up to real time savings across your whole team.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
